verdict.rationale: Termius documents several bulk mechanisms: broadcasting input to all sessions in a Workspace, running snippets on multiple hosts at once, importing many hosts from CSV or ~/.ssh, and applying Group-level settings such as jump hosts to every member host. All of this is GUI-driven, and no API was found (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404), so programmatic bulk automation is unevidenced. Missing for 10: API/programmatic bulk operations, bulk edit/delete of hosts and keychain items, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-host execution.
